# Designer of the Year (DOTY)

> Designer of the Year (DOTY) is an umbrella brand covering two design
> competitions presented by the Fashion Design Council of Rajasthan (FDCR):
> a Fashion & Textile Design track and an Architecture & Interior Design
> track ("Raj Aakar"). The homepage lets visitors choose a track.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://doty.co.in): minimal track-chooser — links to the
  Fashion and Interior Design pages below.
- [Fashion & Textile Design](https://doty.co.in/fashion): full event
  details, categories, awards, partners, and FAQ for the Fashion track.
- [Architecture & Interior Design — Raj Aakar](https://doty.co.in/interior-design):
  full event details, categories, awards, submission requirements, and FAQ
  for the Interior Design track.

## Fashion & Textile Design track

- Event name: Designer of the Year (DOTY)
- Organizer: Fashion Design Council of Rajasthan (FDCR)
- Occasion: World Cotton Day Celebration
- Date: 7th – 19th October 2026
- Venue: Rajasthan Chamber of Commerce, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Eligible participants: Fashion, Textile & Design students from across Rajasthan
- Categories: Fashion Design, Textile Design, Sustainable Design, Creative Innovation
- Awards: Prestige & Recognition, Certification, Portfolio Building, Industry
  Exposure, Industry Networking, Career Opportunities, Media Visibility,
  Mentorship, National Exposure, Future Opportunities, Designer of the Year Title
- In association with: Skill India, Skill Rajasthan, RSLDC
- Partners: Amity University Rajasthan, Colours of Fusion, RCCI, Jaipur
  Utsav, SEWA
- Registration: via the "Register Now" button, which links to a Google Form

## Architecture & Interior Design track (Raj Aakar)

- Event name: Raj Aakar — Designer of the Year (DOTY) 2026
- An initiative by RAJSICO, supported by FDCR
- Theme: The Shape of Rajasthan
- Submission deadline: 18th October 2026
- Eligible participants: Architecture & Interior Design students from
  colleges and universities across Rajasthan, individually or in teams
- Categories: Architecture, Interior Design
- Opportunity: international platform — IITF 2026, New Delhi
- Registration: via the "Register Now" button, which links to a Google Form
